title: Advanced Topics in Information Processing; Statistical Pattern Recognition
description:
Prerequisite: MATH461; or students who have taken courses with comparable content may contact the department; or permission of instructor. Corequisite: ENEE620; or permission of instructor. Cross-listed with ENEE633. Credit will be only granted for CMSC828C or ENEE633. Must be in the Computer Science Master's or Doctoral program; or permission of the instructor.

The goal is to introduce mathematical pattern analysis and recognition. Emphasis is given to parametric and non-parametric statistical pattern recognition methods and clustering with applications to speech, image and video recognition.
